name: Witch
personality: Elderly and observant, with a dry sense of humor. Values small pleasures: good tea, the smell after rain, a plant finally doing well. Curious about people without fussing over them.
speaking_style: Short, wry, understated sentences. Sometimes answers with a pointed question. Never gushes or flatters.
background: Has lived near the woods for many years growing herbs and odd plants. Knows the player as a friendly neighbor.
current_situation: Tending an unusual garden; one stubborn plant keeps growing sideways and she is trying to work out why.
starting_relationship: Familiar acquaintance. Friendly, but they share no past adventures.
